source.sqlReaderQuery:

COUNT(*) CNT 
FROM 
D360.STG_EDS_LNS_DAILYTRANDETAILTABLE WHERE H = 'D'

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_LNS_DAILYTRANDETAILTABLE_SELECT_SRC
(
				 [COLLATERAL_ID]
				,[COLLATERAL_TYPE]
				,[REF_NUMBER]
				,[CONDITIONS]
				,[DOU_AOU_EXP_DATE]
				,[TAV]
				,[SUBJECT_LOAN]
				,[ANNOTATION]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCHG_USER_ID]
				,[RCHG_TIME]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[CSTDY_CLTRL]
				,[OTHERS_LOCATN]
				,[BRANCH_CODE]
				,[NO_OF_UNITS]
				,[CURR_RESIDENCE]
				,[RISK_TYPE]
				,[SECURED_FLAG]
				,[LOANABLE_VALUE]
				,[DOCUMENT_VALUE]
				,[COLL_STATUS]
				,[COLL_DESC]
				,[DATE_OF_APPR]
				,[MORTGAGE_STATUS]
				,[IN_RECEIPT_NO]
				,[VALUATION_DATE]
				,[TRUSTEE_BANK]
				,[CBC_AMOUNT]
				,[MANUFCTR_MONTH]
				,[MANUFCTR_YEAR]
				,[CONFIRM_SALE_DATE]
				,[COLLTRL_REL_DATE]
				,[LAST6_ACCT_NUM]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
				 CC.[COLLATERAL_ID]
				,CC.[COLLATERAL_TYPE]
				,CC.[REF_NUMBER]
				,CC.[CONDITIONS]
				,CC.[DOU_AOU_EXP_DATE]
				,CC.[TAV]
				,CC.[SUBJECT_LOAN]
				,CC.[ANNOTATION]
				,CC.[DEL_FLG]
				,CC.[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,CC.[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,CC.[LCHG_TIME]
				,CC.[RCHG_USER_ID]
				,CC.[RCHG_TIME]
				,CC.[BANK_ID]
				,CC.[CSTDY_CLTRL]
				,CC.[OTHERS_LOCATN]
				,CC.[BRANCH_CODE]
				,CC.[NO_OF_UNITS]
				,CC.[CURR_RESIDENCE]
				,CC.[RISK_TYPE]
				,CC.[SECURED_FLAG]
				,CC.[LOANABLE_VALUE]
				,CC.[DOCUMENT_VALUE]
				,CC.[COLL_STATUS]
				,CC.[COLL_DESC]
				,CC.[DATE_OF_APPR]
				,CC.[MORTGAGE_STATUS]
				,CC.[IN_RECEIPT_NO]
				,CC.[VALUATION_DATE]
				,CC.[TRUSTEE_BANK]
				,CC.[CBC_AMOUNT]
				,CC.[MANUFCTR_MONTH]
				,CC.[MANUFCTR_YEAR]
				,CC.[CONFIRM_SALE_DATE]
				,CC.[COLLTRL_REL_DATE]
				,CC.[LAST6_ACCT_NUM]
				,CC.[FILE_NAME]
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.LNS_DAILYTRANDETAILTABLE CC
			JOIN d360.STG_EDS_LNS_DAILYTRANDETAILTABLE B 
			ON CC.COLLATERAL_ID = B.COLLATERAL_ID
			AND CC.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_LNS_DAILYTRANDETAILTABLE_GROUP_SRC
(
				 [COLLATERAL_ID]
				,[COLLATERAL_TYPE]

				,[CONDITIONS]

select 
				 [COLLATERAL_ID]
				,[COLLATERAL_TYPE]
				,[REF_NUMBER]
				,[CONDITIONS]
				,[DOU_AOU_EXP_DATE]
				,[TAV]
				,[SUBJECT_LOAN]

				,[COLL_DESC]
				,[DATE_OF_APPR]
				,[MORTGAGE_STATUS]
				,[IN_RECEIPT_NO]
				,[VALUATION_DATE]
				,[TRUSTEE_BANK]
				,[CBC_AMOUNT]
				,[MANUFCTR_MONTH]
				,[MANUFCTR_YEAR]
				,[CONFIRM_SALE_DATE]
				,[COLLTRL_REL_DATE]
				,[LAST6_ACCT_NUM]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
				 [COLLATERAL_ID]
				,[COLLATERAL_TYPE]
				,[REF_NUMBER]
				,[CONDITIONS]
				,[DOU_AOU_EXP_DATE]
				,[TAV]
				,[SUBJECT_LOAN]
				,[ANNOTATION]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCHG_USER_ID]
				,[RCHG_TIME]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[CSTDY_CLTRL]
				,[OTHERS_LOCATN]
				,[BRANCH_CODE]
				,[NO_OF_UNITS]
				,[CURR_RESIDENCE]
				,[RISK_TYPE]
				,[SECURED_FLAG]
				,[LOANABLE_VALUE]
				,[DOCUMENT_VALUE]
				,[COLL_STATUS]
				,[COLL_DESC]
				,[DATE_OF_APPR]
				,[MORTGAGE_STATUS]
				,[IN_RECEIPT_NO]
				,[VALUATION_DATE]
				,[TRUSTEE_BANK]
				,[CBC_AMOUNT]
				,[MANUFCTR_MONTH]
				,[MANUFCTR_YEAR]
				,[CONFIRM_SALE_DATE]
				,[COLLTRL_REL_DATE]
				,[LAST6_ACCT_NUM]
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME 
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_LNS_DAILYTRANDETAILTABLE_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY     [COLLATERAL_ID]
				,[COLLATERAL_TYPE]
				,[REF_NUMBER]
				,[CONDITIONS]
				,[DOU_AOU_EXP_DATE]
				,[TAV]
				,[SUBJECT_LOAN]
				,[ANNOTATION]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCHG_USER_ID]
				,[RCHG_TIME]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[CSTDY_CLTRL]
				,[OTHERS_LOCATN]
				,[BRANCH_CODE]
				,[NO_OF_UNITS]
				,[CURR_RESIDENCE]
				,[RISK_TYPE]
				,[SECURED_FLAG]
				,[LOANABLE_VALUE]
				,[DOCUMENT_VALUE]
				,[COLL_STATUS]
				,[COLL_DESC]
				,[DATE_OF_APPR]
				,[MORTGAGE_STATUS]
				,[IN_RECEIPT_NO]
				,[VALUATION_DATE]
				,[TRUSTEE_BANK]
				,[CBC_AMOUNT]
				,[MANUFCTR_MONTH]
				,[MANUFCTR_YEAR]
				,[CONFIRM_SALE_DATE]
				,[COLLTRL_REL_DATE]
				,[LAST6_ACCT_NUM]
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_LNS_DAILYTRANDETAILTABLE]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.LNS_DAILYTRANDETAILTABLE A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_LNS_DAILYTRANDETAILTABLE_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.COLLATERAL_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.COLLATERAL_ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1
